title: Advanced solar-driven interfacial evaporation technology for resource and energy recovery
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,446-459
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05041C, Perspective
Xiaoqiang Cui, Shicheng Dong, Ningning Cao, Xuchen Zhang, Junxia Wang, Haiguang Fu, Beibei Yan, Zhen Yu, Miao Yu, Guanyi Chen
This perspective reviews the solar-driven interfacial evaporation (SIE) system for resource and energy recovery, while proposing new dynamics and thermodynamic frameworks to support the design and practical application of SIE systems.
